# 7Cs Designs

> A small print studio in Falmouth, Cornwall, England making chart-style art prints of harbours, bays and lighthouses on cotton rag paper. Decorative prints only, not for navigation.

## Pages
- [Home](https://7csdesigns.com/): what the studio makes, prices and questions
- [Harbour prints](https://7csdesigns.com/harbour-prints.html): how harbours are drawn, colourways, catalogue, prices
- [Lighthouse prints](https://7csdesigns.com/lighthouse-prints.html): the lighthouse series, sizes and prices
- [Framing and sizes](https://7csdesigns.com/framing-and-sizes.html): A4/A3/A2, cotton rag paper, oak frames, acrylic glazing
- [The print studio](https://7csdesigns.com/the-print-studio.html): about the studio and how orders run
- [Order a print](https://7csdesigns.com/order-a-print.html): order request form
- [Delivery](https://7csdesigns.com/delivery.html) · [Returns](https://7csdesigns.com/print-returns.html)

## Prices (GBP)
A4 unframed £28 · A3 unframed £42 · A2 unframed £64 · A3 oak frame £98 · A2 oak frame £145 · gift tube + card £6

Contact: prints@7csdesigns.com
